question: Can a clause-scope structural cue separate merge assertions from merge mentions on the frozen union corpora where the four lexical-window arms failed?
selection_basis: audit lead direction_update audit-l07-direction-separability-20260912T010517: 'the next attempt must use a structure/topology cue (clause or dependency structure), not another lexical window'. No assignment card existed in comms/inbox/worker-040.jsonl.
method: Pre-registered rule STRUCTURAL_R1, then two disclosed post-hoc revisions (see AMENDMENTS.json). Decision unit is the clause: quotation scope, negation scope over the unity predicate, matrix/meta frame roles, intra-sentential antecedent, plus canonical declaration-surface semantics. No character-window proximity test. Fully deterministic, stdlib only, read-only on every shared artifact.

corpus_c_assertion_mention.fn_reason: no composite token in the isolated fixture; cross-sentence antecedent deliberately not attempted

worker035_holdout_battery.caveat: P07/P09 motivated amendment A9; the holdout is not independent evidence for those two patterns

harness_reproduction_control.note: C1: the same harness reproduces the published r3 adjudication numbers for the three lexical arms at their pinned bytes

controls.C3_no_canonical_write: PASS (sentinel hashes of 9 canonical paths unchanged)
controls.C5_directional_controls: PASS (quoted unity with endorsement fires; merge prohibition silent)
controls.C6_pin_drift_guard: PASS (all inputs hash-verified at load, fail-closed)

interpretation.what_is_supported: On the frozen labeled corpora and the six pinned controls, the clause-scope structural cue meets the audit lead's adoption bar that the four lexical arms did not, and it clears the 19 hard findings of the canonical arm on the frozen map snapshot that are all labeled metalinguistic false positives, while retaining 17/17 corpus-A leaks, 5/6 corpus-C assertions, 12/12 + 10/10 adversarial assertions and 6/6 worker-098 FN probes.
interpretation.what_is_not_supported: Not an adoption, not a gate verdict, not independent generalization: the corpus-A/C rules were authored with those corpora visible, two holdout positives were used for A9, the live census is one snapshot, and no independent reviewer has reproduced the run. The claim is about this prototype at this pinned revision on these frozen bytes only.
residual_risks: rule-level overfitting to the labeled corpora is not excluded
0 live hard findings could mask genuine assertions on later map bytes
the detector-write freeze and the pending astra-life06-classsep-detector-adjudication are unaffected by this probe

recommended_next_step: If the audit lead wants to pursue this direction: (1) an independent reviewer re-runs run_battery.py at the pinned hashes; (2) the structural cue is scored on a freshly authored held-out corpus (new fixtures, authored after this artifact, not visible to worker-040); (3) only then consider a staged candidate under proposed/ with a full four-arm comparison. Corpus-A/C rules should not be adopted on this worker's own endpoint.
